snippet.title: Blue Check - Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Blue Check is OUT NOW on ITCHIO
➡️https://pidoproductions.itch.io/blue-check

Follow the dev social page to get all the development news!
➡️ https://www.instagram.com/pidoproductions/

🔍 ABOUT THE GAME

Official trailer for Blue Check, a brand new indie puzzle horror game on Itch.io.
Start a cozy life in your new house. Check the news, buy items, play games, and chat with your friends! 
But things are a bit deeper than that... Will you find the truth?

If you enjoy psychological horror games with personal and relatable stories, this is the indie game you've been waiting for.

DISCLAIMER - The NPCs in the game use local AI generation to reply to your messages. 
NO ONLINE AI SERVICES HAVE ACCESS TO THE GAME. 
NO AI-GENERATED ASSETS. 

#HorrorGames #IndieHorror #Itchio #Gaming #PuzzleHorror #IndieDev #GameTrailer
